description: A fresh clone of the repo imports vesper.nodes without error
steps: Clone the repo into a scratch directory with: git clone . /tmp/vesper-clone-check
From that clone, run: python3 -c 'import vesper.nodes'
Confirm it does NOT raise ModuleNotFoundError for swarm_node or synthesis_node
If it does, either commit vesper/agents/ + swarm_node.py + synthesis_node.py, or revert the vesper/nodes/__init__.py change
Re-run the clone check and confirm a clean import
Delete the scratch clone

description: The in-flight multi-agent work is either committed whole or reverted whole — never half-wired
steps: Review git diff for vesper/graph.py, vesper/state.py, vesper/nodes/reflection.py, vesper/nodes/__init__.py
Review the untracked vesper/agents/*.py, vesper/nodes/swarm_node.py, vesper/nodes/synthesis_node.py
Run: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_agents_specialists.py tests/test_multi_agent_graph.py
Confirm 11 tests pass
Decide: commit the whole set, or revert the graph/state/reflection/__init__ edits so the tree is consistent
Whichever you choose, the tree must import cleanly and the full suite must stay green
Record the decision and its reason in claude-progress.txt

description: The two rule-5 artefacts are gitignored and never staged
steps: Add 'Cash Secured Puts-*.csv' and 'Screenshot *.png' to .gitignore
Run: git status --short
Confirm neither the CSV nor the screenshot appears as untracked or staged
Confirm neither file has ever been committed: git log --all --oneline -- '*.csv' '*.png'

description: The Webull SDK is pinned to 2.0.18 in requirements.txt
steps: Edit requirements.txt line 19: webull-openapi-python-sdk==2.0.18
Confirm the locally installed version matches: python3 -m pip show webull-openapi-python-sdk
Update CLAUDE.md, which currently documents 2.0.16
Note the fleet split (local 2.0.18, coolify 2.0.18, supermcp 2.0.12) in claude-progress.txt

description: A clean-venv install of requirements-dev.txt can still collect the whole test suite
steps: Create a throwaway venv: python3 -m venv /tmp/vesper-clean-venv
Install into it: /tmp/vesper-clean-venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
Run: /tmp/vesper-clean-venv/bin/python -m pytest --collect-only -q
Confirm collection succeeds with no import errors (this is the only check that catches missing transitive deps like tradingview_screener and fastmcp)
Remove the throwaway venv

description: The full test suite passes and the count is recorded as the new floor
steps: Run: python3 -m pytest -q
Confirm the suite is green with at least 570 passing
Write the exact number into claude-progress.txt as the floor for later sessions

description: Everything from M1 is committed and pushed
steps: Run git status --short and read it before staging
Stage specific paths only; confirm no .env, CSV, screenshot or .claude_settings.json is included
Commit with a conventional message describing the M1 changes
Run: git push
Confirm: git status is clean apart from deliberately-ignored files

description: The current static-bearer auth path is characterised by tests before anything changes
steps: Read trading_mcp/server.py's _build_auth() and the MCP_TRANSPORT handling
Write tests asserting: no TRADING_AGENT_TOKEN plus http transport refuses to start
Write a test asserting a request with no credential is rejected
Write a test asserting a request with a valid bearer is accepted
Run the new tests and confirm they pass against the CURRENT implementation
These are the regression net for everything that follows

description: Token comparison uses hmac.compare_digest everywhere
steps: Search trading_mcp/ for any == comparison against a token or secret
Replace each with hmac.compare_digest
Add a test that the comparison helper is used (import-level or behavioural)
Run: python3 -m pytest -q

description: An OAuth 2.1 authorization server is mounted on the MCP app
steps: Research FastMCP's auth= parameter and its OAuth provider support for the installed version
Implement the OAuth 2.1 provider in a new module under trading_mcp/
Mount the standard discovery endpoints so a client can find the authorization and token endpoints
Do NOT add a user model — this is a single-operator system; authorization means 'carries a credential Michael provisioned'
Add tests covering the discovery endpoints returning well-formed metadata

description: Dynamic client registration works end to end
steps: Implement the dynamic client registration endpoint
Write a test that registers a client, receives credentials, and completes the authorization code exchange
Confirm the resulting access token is accepted by the MCP endpoint
Confirm an unregistered client cannot obtain a token

description: Both auth paths converge on a single authorization decision
steps: Confirm there is exactly ONE function that decides whether a request is authorized
Confirm the static bearer verifier and the OAuth verifier both route through it
Read docs/SUPERMCP_SWAGGER_AND_AUTH_PLAN.md and the handoff notes on supermcp's authorize() bug, where an OAuth handshake force-granted admin
Add a test asserting that an OAuth handshake cannot escalate beyond the scopes it was granted
Write the reasoning into a comment at the decision function, since this is the exact shape that went wrong once already

description: The static bearer still works as a fallback after OAuth lands
steps: Run the M2-01 characterisation tests again unchanged
Confirm all still pass
Confirm the server still refuses to start on http without TRADING_AGENT_TOKEN

description: Tokens are revocable and stored outside git with 0600 permissions
steps: Implement token storage under the existing data/ state directory pattern (atomic write, same as halt.py)
Confirm the path is gitignored
Implement revocation and add a test: issue a token, use it successfully, revoke it, confirm it is then rejected
Register the new state file in tests/conftest.py's _isolated_vesper_state autouse fixture

description: The rule-3 AST pin covers every new module added in M2
steps: Read tests/test_trading_mcp.py and confirm how it discovers modules to scan
Confirm the new OAuth module(s) are inside its scan set
Confirm the pin still matches attribute access, aliased imports and dotted access — do NOT narrow it to ast.Call
Run: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_trading_mcp.py

description: An unauthenticated request to /mcp returns 4xx on the live box
steps: Deploy the M2 changes to coolify (git pull in ~/trading-agent, install any new deps into its venv)
Restart: ssh coolify 'systemctl --user restart trading-agent.service'
Confirm active: ssh coolify 'systemctl --user is-active trading-agent.service'
Confirm the bind is still the docker bridge and never 0.0.0.0: ssh coolify 'ss -ltnp | grep 8500'
From the box, request the endpoint with no credential and confirm a 4xx
A 200 here is a FAILED feature, not a passing one

description: The Traefik dynamic config is rewritten to match whatever M2 changed
steps: Read the staged config at coolify:~/trading-agent.yaml
If OAuth added routes outside /mcp that must be reachable, update the router rules to cover them
Write the updated file to coolify:~/trading-agent.yaml (this needs no sudo)
Record in claude-progress.txt that H1 must be re-run by a human for the change to take effect

description: The trimmed credential set is defined and written to .env.example
steps: List exactly the variables coolify needs: WEBULL_APP_KEY, WEBULL_APP_SECRET, WEBULL_KEY, WEBULL_SECRET, WEBULL_REGION_ID, WEBULL_ENVIRONMENT, TD_API_KEY, TDPRO_API_KEY, SEC_USER_AGENT, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_AUTHORIZED_USER_IDS, TRADING_AGENT_TOKEN, VESPER_TRADING
Confirm no OpenRouter, Discord or ntfy variable is included — that box does not need them
Write .env.example with names and placeholder values only, never a real value
Confirm .env.example is safe to commit and commit it

description: Credentials reach coolify without any value appearing in the transcript
steps: Build the trimmed env file locally by filtering the local .env to the names from M3-01, writing to a temp file
Transfer it with scp — never echo, cat or print a value
Set permissions: ssh coolify 'chmod 600 ~/trading-agent/.env'
Remove the local temp file
Verify by NAME only: ssh coolify 'sed -n "s/^\\([A-Z_]*\\)=.*/\\1/p" ~/trading-agent/.env'
Confirm VESPER_TRADING=0 is present

description: The account tools return real data, verified by shape and never by value
steps: Restart the service: ssh coolify 'systemctl --user restart trading-agent.service'
Call get_account_state through the MCP endpoint
Assert the response has available: true and contains an 'equity' key
Do NOT print the equity value, the account number, or any position detail
Record only 'account tools returning live data: yes' in claude-progress.txt

description: The TDPro-backed momentum tools return live data on coolify
steps: Call a tier-1 momentum tool that depends on TD_API_KEY
Confirm it no longer returns available: false
Confirm the response decodes cleanly with no mojibake (td.py pins the charset because TDPro does not declare one)

description: The EDGAR tools work on coolify
steps: Confirm SEC_USER_AGENT is set on the box
Call an EDGAR-backed tool and confirm a successful response shape
Confirm a missing SEC_USER_AGENT degrades rather than crashing

description: Rate-limit discipline is preserved on the remote box
steps: Confirm account reads still go through wb.py's locked, backed-off client (2 req/2s bucket)
Confirm market data reads still go through md.Market (600/min bucket)
Confirm wb.py and md.py remain separate modules
Add or confirm a test that a burst of account reads does not exceed the scarce bucket

description: A missing credential still degrades rather than crashing
steps: Add a test that constructs a tool call with the relevant env var unset
Confirm the result is {'available': false, ...} and no exception escapes
Run: python3 -m pytest -q

description: The repo on coolify is updated to the current pushed HEAD
steps: ssh coolify 'git -C ~/trading-agent fetch && git -C ~/trading-agent status'
Pull the latest pushed commit
Install any new dependencies into that box's venv
Confirm: ssh coolify '~/trading-agent/.venv/bin/python -c "import vesper.nodes"'

description: The full test suite passes on the coolify box itself
steps: Run the suite remotely: ssh coolify 'cd ~/trading-agent && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q'
Confirm the count matches the local floor
If it does not, investigate the environment difference before deploying anything that runs

description: Memory headroom is measured before adding two more processes
steps: Record baseline: ssh coolify 'free -m'
Record the MCP server's RSS: ssh coolify 'ps -o rss=,cmd= -C python'
Estimate the additional footprint of the loop and listen processes
Confirm the box (~2.4 GB available, ~10 unrelated containers) has room
Record the numbers in claude-progress.txt

description: vesper-loop.service exists as a systemd user unit and starts cleanly
steps: Write the unit file for 'vesper.py loop --live', reading ~/trading-agent/.env, with Restart=on-failure
Install it under the user systemd directory and reload the daemon
Enable and start it
Confirm: ssh coolify 'systemctl --user is-active vesper-loop.service'
Confirm the journal shows the monitor task started and the scan schedule registered
Confirm VESPER_TRADING is still 0

description: vesper-listen.service exists as a systemd user unit and starts cleanly
steps: Write the unit file for 'vesper.py listen'
Install, reload, enable and start it
Confirm: ssh coolify 'systemctl --user is-active vesper-listen.service'
Confirm the journal shows Telegram long-polling started
Confirm no inbound port was opened: ssh coolify 'ss -ltnp' and check nothing new is listening

description: All three units survive a restart and come back automatically
steps: Restart each unit in turn and confirm it returns to active
Confirm lingering is enabled so the units survive logout: ssh coolify 'loginctl show-user $USER | grep Linger'
Kill one process to simulate a crash and confirm systemd restarts it
Confirm the MCP server is still bound to the docker bridge afterwards

description: The two processes agree on state file locations and do not corrupt each other
steps: Confirm the halt file, circuit breaker file, paper ledger, approval registry and SQLite checkpoint paths resolve identically for both units
Confirm concurrent access to the SQLite checkpoint is safe (WAL mode or serialised access)
Write a test that two processes writing the approval registry concurrently do not lose a record
Run: python3 -m pytest -q

description: The alert watcher runs inside the loop process as a thread, not an asyncio task
steps: Confirm the watcher is started by vesper/alerts_runner.py as a background thread
Confirm it is NOT converted to an asyncio task — the Webull SDK is blocking and would stall the graph and the Telegram poller
Confirm a TDPro outage silences dynamic alerts rather than firing them on a stale level

description: The circuit breaker and halt file are honoured by the remote loop
steps: Confirm the loop checks halt state before firing each scheduled scan
Trigger a halt remotely and confirm the next scheduled scan is skipped, not queued
Resume and confirm scanning resumes
Confirm the circuit breaker's trailing-peak drawdown threshold is configured on the box

description: chromadb is either installed with measured headroom or its absence is asserted to be quiet
steps: Check whether chromadb is installed on coolify
If memory allows, install it and confirm trade memory ingestion works
If not, add a test asserting recall_similar_setups returns available: false without raising when chromadb is absent
Record which path was taken and why in claude-progress.txt

description: Only one Telegram poller can hold the bot token at a time
steps: Implement a guard that detects an already-running poller (lock file, or a startup getUpdates conflict check)
Make the second one refuse to start with a clear message rather than silently stealing updates
Add a test for the refusal
Document in CLAUDE.md that the laptop poller must be stopped when the remote one runs

description: TELEGRAM_AUTHORIZED_USER_IDS fails closed when unset
steps: Read vesper/bot/inbound.py:57-77, which currently allows with a warning when the variable is unset
Change it to deny when unset
Add a test: unset variable plus any callback equals denied
Add a test: a user id not in the list is denied even if another is
Confirm the variable is set on coolify

description: Authorization is enforced on every callback, not only the first
steps: Add a test that sends two callbacks from an unauthorized user and confirms both are rejected
Add a test that an authorized user's second callback still passes the check
Run: python3 -m pytest -q

description: A proposal generated on coolify reaches Telegram with working buttons
steps: With VESPER_TRADING=0 and paper mode, trigger a scan on the box that produces a proposal
Confirm a Telegram message arrives with Approve and Reject inline buttons
Confirm the proposal is registered in the approval registry
Do not include any account value in the confirmation you record

description: A button press resolves the proposal and resumes the graph
steps: Press Approve on the test proposal
Confirm ApprovalRegistry.submit_decision records the decision
Confirm the paused LangGraph thread resumes
Confirm the decision appears in the audit trail

description: A pending approval survives a restart of the listen unit
steps: Create a pending proposal and leave it unanswered
Restart vesper-listen.service
Confirm the proposal is still pending
Press the button and confirm it still resolves correctly
Add an automated test covering the same restart cycle

description: A pending approval survives a restart of the loop unit
steps: Create a pending proposal and leave it unanswered
Restart vesper-loop.service
Confirm the paused graph thread is recovered from the SQLite checkpointer
Press the button and confirm the graph resumes from where it paused

description: The approval path stays outbound-only
steps: Confirm vesper/bot/inbound.py's aiohttp webhook app is still not started by anything
Confirm ss -ltnp on coolify shows no new listening port beyond the MCP server's bridge bind
Add or confirm a test asserting the webhook app is not wired into any entrypoint

description: Approvals cannot be granted by anything other than a button press
steps: Confirm no MCP tool can call submit_decision — tests/test_trading_mcp.py's AST pin covers this
Confirm no voice or text command path can approve a proposal
Confirm /halt and /resume text commands still work and are authorization-checked
Run: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_trading_mcp.py

description: A full paper-mode session runs on coolify without an unhandled exception
steps: Run the loop in paper mode across at least one full scheduled session
Confirm scans fired at their scheduled times
Confirm no unhandled exception appears in the journal
Record the observation window in claude-progress.txt

description: Proposals, approvals and exits round-trip in paper mode
steps: Confirm at least one proposal was generated
Confirm the approval round-trip completed
Confirm the position monitor evaluated open paper positions
Confirm the exit cascade fired where its conditions were met

description: The audit chain verifies after the soak
steps: Call verify_audit_chain through the MCP endpoint
Confirm the chain verifies with no break
Confirm every approval decision from the soak appears in it

description: Memory is stable across the soak
steps: Record RSS for all three units at the start and end of the soak
Confirm no unbounded growth
If growth is present, identify the source before proceeding

description: The kill switch and halt both work from the remote box
steps: Confirm VESPER_TRADING=0 blocks the order path even with a valid approved ticket
Trigger halt and confirm the guard refuses before any other check
Confirm resume restores normal operation
Add a test if one does not already cover the remote configuration

description: docs/ARMING.md exists and is precise enough to follow under pressure
steps: Write docs/ARMING.md covering: preconditions from M6-01 to M6-05, the exact commands to set VESPER_TRADING=1 and restart, what to watch in Webull Desktop, and how to abort with vesper.py halt
State the standing rule that the first live order is one share of something cheap with Webull Desktop open
State plainly that the box holds live credentials and is internet-facing
Do NOT arm it yourself

description: VESPER_TRADING is still 0 at the end of the run
steps: Verify by name and value that VESPER_TRADING=0 on coolify
Confirm no commit, script or unit file sets it to 1
Record this explicitly in claude-progress.txt

description: The stale deploy/ artefacts are retired rather than left to mislead
steps: Review deploy/install.sh, deploy/sidecar.service and deploy/legacy_sidecar_mcp_server.py.bak
Delete or clearly mark as retired everything describing the pre-migration run.sh/port-8787 layout
Confirm nothing in the repo still refers to SIDECAR_HOST or port 8787 as current

description: A new install script reproduces the live deployment from scratch
steps: Write a script that creates the venv, installs pinned requirements, installs all three systemd user units, enables lingering, and prints the .env contract by name
It must never write a credential value
It must be idempotent — running it twice changes nothing the second time

description: The three systemd unit files live in the repo
steps: Add the unit files for the MCP server, vesper-loop and vesper-listen under deploy/
Confirm each specifies the correct working directory, venv python, EnvironmentFile and Restart policy
Confirm the MCP unit's bind address is the docker bridge, never 0.0.0.0

description: The Traefik dynamic config lives in the repo alongside the sudo step that installs it
steps: Commit the dynamic config as deploy/traefik/trading-agent.yaml
Document the sudo command a human must run to install it, and that Traefik requests the cert on first hit
Document that an unauthenticated request must return 4xx and that a 200 means auth is not gating

description: The DNS and hostname facts are documented, including the wildcard footgun
steps: Document agent.mphinance.com pointing at the coolify box
Document that *.mphinance.com points at vultr, so a typo'd hostname silently lands on the wrong machine and returns a confusing 503
Put this where someone debugging a 503 will actually find it

description: The install script is verified by running it against the live box
steps: Run the script on coolify
Confirm all three units are active afterwards
Confirm the MCP bind is unchanged
Run it a second time and confirm nothing changed

description: A restart of the whole box brings everything back
steps: Confirm lingering is enabled and all three units are enabled
Confirm the units would start on boot without a login
Document how to verify this after any future reboot

description: A single get_current_state tool answers the most common spoken question in one call
steps: Add a read-only MCP tool composing account state, open positions, pending proposals and armed alerts
Keep the response small enough to be read aloud — a summary, not a dump
Confirm it degrades to available: false per-section rather than failing whole
Add tests for the composed shape and for partial degradation
Confirm the rule-3 AST pin covers the new module

description: get_account_state bounds its positions payload
steps: Read trading_mcp/vesper_tools.py:83-93, which returns Webull's raw positions list unbounded
Add a limit and a summary count so a large account does not produce an unreadable response
Add a test with a large synthetic positions list

description: get_audit_trail defaults to a spoken-friendly size
steps: Read trading_mcp/vesper_tools.py:243, where the default limit is 20 full JSON entries
Reduce the default and add a compact summary mode
Keep the full detail available when explicitly requested
Add a test

description: Dealer-gamma answers use the compacted level shape, never the raw payload
steps: Confirm every voice-facing tool that touches gamma uses td.levels() (~1.3KB) and not get_gex_ticker's raw ~200 strikes / ~40KB
Confirm flip_split is surfaced when the two flip sources straddle spot, rather than silently picking one
Add a test asserting the compacted shape is what is returned

description: Symbol arguments resolve fuzzily and echo back what was matched
steps: Add fuzzy resolution for tools taking a ticker, so a mis-transcription like 'in video' can still resolve to NVDA
Always include the resolved symbol in the response so a wrong match is audible before it matters
Return a clear ambiguity result rather than guessing when two candidates are close
Add tests covering a clean match, a fuzzy match and an ambiguous one

description: Gamma levels are never phrased as price targets
steps: Review the tool descriptions and any summary text for language implying price will travel to a level
State that dealer gamma marks where hedging is concentrated, which is why price often reacts there
Confirm no tool description reads a wall above spot as a reason to be long

description: Every voice-originated tool call is logged to the audit trail
steps: Add audit logging for MCP tool invocations, capturing the tool, arguments and timestamp
Confirm it does not log credential values
Add a test asserting an MCP call appears in the audit trail
This is the surviving requirement from the cancelled rule 4d: audio is ephemeral, the log is what makes it reviewable

description: No speech-to-text, audio endpoint or voice command path exists in this repo
steps: Confirm no OpenRouter STT code was added
Confirm no audio upload endpoint exists
Confirm no voice path can approve, halt, resume or place anything
Add a test asserting no MCP tool can reach submit_decision, halt or resume

description: CLAUDE.md rule 1 is rewritten to describe the real network posture
steps: Replace the claim that nothing in this repo serves HTTP
Describe what actually exists: docker-bridge bind, Traefik-fronted with TLS, OAuth 2.1 with a static-bearer fallback, owner-only
State plainly that the box holds live broker credentials and can place orders
Name the controls that make that survivable: single order module, ticket handshake, kill switch defaulting off, halt file, circuit breaker
Do not describe it as loopback

description: CLAUDE.md rule 4d is replaced with the claude.ai voice design
steps: Remove the Telegram voice note plus OpenRouter STT design
Describe the replacement: voice is a client concern, this repo exposes read-only tools, no STT and no audio endpoint live here
Keep the surviving constraint verbatim in spirit: voice asks questions, buttons move money — approvals never become a voice command
Keep the two failure modes that still apply: ticker mis-transcription and oversized payloads
Mark ROADMAP.md's LLM-layer-and-voice section as superseded rather than deleting the reasoning

description: CLAUDE.md's Status, Layout and test count are accurate
steps: Update the test count to the real current number
Update the Layout tree with any new modules
Update the Status section to reflect what now runs on coolify
Update the deploy/ description after M7

description: The superseded supermcp consolidation docs point at the current decision
steps: Add a one-line superseded note at the top of docs/SUPERMCP_CONSOLIDATION_PLAN.md, SUPERMCP_EXECUTION_PLAN.md, SUPERMCP_VS_VESPER_TOOLS.md and SUPERMCP_REMOTE_STATE.md
State that trading-agent stays its own process and its own connector
Do not delete the documents — the reasoning is still useful

description: ROADMAP.md reflects the work done and the work deliberately not done
steps: Tick the items this run completed
Add the items this run created and deferred
Record the multi-agent follow-ups still open: live debate transcripts, and agent_conviction_weights which exists in state but is never populated

description: No credential, balance, account number or ntfy topic exists anywhere in git history from this run
steps: Search the diff of every commit made during this run for credential patterns
Confirm CI's credential scan passes
Confirm .env, the positions CSV and the screenshot were never committed
Record the check in claude-progress.txt

description: BLOCKED (needs sudo): install the Traefik dynamic config so TLS goes live
steps: This cannot be done by the agent — Traefik's dynamic directory requires root

description: BLOCKED (needs a browser): add the connector in claude.ai
steps: Human adds https://agent.mphinance.com/mcp under Settings then Connectors
Use the OAuth flow from M2 once it is live; the static bearer stays documented as the fallback
Then confirm the tools appear in a normal chat, and in voice mode on mobile
Agent: leave this false and keep the instructions current

description: BLOCKED (human decision): arm live trading
steps: Human sets VESPER_TRADING=1 on coolify and restarts the loop unit
Only after every M6 precondition holds and docs/ARMING.md is written
First live order is one share of something cheap with Webull Desktop open

description: BLOCKED (verification only): confirm voice works end to end on the phone
steps: Human opens voice mode on Claude mobile with the connector enabled
Ask: what is my current state, what is pending, where is the flip
Confirm the answers come back promptly and are short enough to be spoken
